description: Precision spot-check of the Q4 METHODS regexes. Question per item: does the paper USE the technique (experimental: the authors measured with it; computational: the authors ran the calculation), judged from title+abstract, not merely mention it.
sampling: v2 sample: trailing-window in-scope arXiv records carrying the method tag in analysis/classified.jsonl, sorted ids, random.Random(7).sample(ids, 10). Printed by: methods.py --audit-sample
threshold: methods with v2 precision < 0.70 are refined in analysis/methods.py (REFINED_METHODS)
judge: single annotator (LLM agent) reading title+abstract; borderline calls are noted per item
